entries.description: Enumerated ../AccessExporterTemp1/ via find -maxdepth 3 + descended into Enrichment/{Vba,Macros}, AccessMetaData, sample-output, tests/.../{SyntheticDbs,UatGroundTruth}. Captured every .cs / .json / .py / .accdb / .yaml / .md / config file plus all subdirectories.
Read ../AccessExporterTemp1/BATON.md end-to-end (280 lines). Cross-checked claims against actual tree; logged 3 drift items in import-plan.md (git presence, missing tests/Fixtures, test-file count).

Drafted import-plan.md with one row per sibling-folder/file under import-as-is / import-with-edits / rebuild / out-of-scope. Surfaced 5 open questions for human (2 from spec + 3 net new from drift check).
Routed import-plan.md draft to route(task_type='planning') for independent disposition-list review.

Applied 9 review flags from Opus planning route (2 major + 7 minor). Major fixes: (1) bundled both AccessTextParser bugs (80-char truncation + CR/LF escape) into one open question; (2) made the labels_proximity integration test fate explicit (simplified to pipeline-runs assertion). Added 'Known issues imported as-is' section listing all 6 BATON validator-surfaced follow-ups. Demoted OQ #3 (Gemini-era confirmation) to a confirmatory note in the disposition table per spec already deciding it. Final import-plan.md is 398 lines.
Skipped per spec: 'Build + test: not applicable (no code yet).' Session 2 creates the solution; first dotnet build is in Session 2.

Cross-provider session-verification via query('gpt-5-4', task_type='session-verification'). Used query() rather than route() because router-config.yaml has no task_type_override for session-verification, so route() would default to opus (Anthropic) and miss the cross-provider intent. Logged as a lessons-learned candidate.

Applied 4 fixes from cross-provider verifier (2 major + 1 minor + 1 OQ-removal). Spec contradiction on FormAndReportDefaults.accdb fixed; SupportedOSPlatform wording normalized; test-count drift row corrected; OQ #3 (parser-bug fix-now-or-defer) removed as a blocking question.
Re-ran cross-provider session verification (Round 2) after applying Round 1 fixes.

Applied 3 fixes from Round 2 verifier (2 major + 1 minor). Stale 'travels with the project file' wording fixed; bucket-completeness issue resolved by changing 8 'flag' rows to 'import-as-is *(pending OQ #N)*'; enricher count corrected.
Round 3 cross-provider session verification (max retries reached on this round).
